topic: Vanna makes credit composable: fragmented capital physically reorganizing into one unified credit layer across Soroban protocols

concepts.creative_concept: The Credit Super-Highway: Building Unified Financial Infrastructure.
concepts.visual_thesis: Vanna visually constructs an intelligent, flowing network that seamlessly connects and optimizes fragmented DeFi capital.
concepts.story_structure: Disparate capital fragments are shown as independent streams, then are channeled into a sophisticated Vanna-powered infrastructure, emerging as a singular, powerful flow directed towards various yield opportunities.
concepts.visual_metaphor: An intricate, self-assembling network of transparent conduits and nodal hubs, physically reorganizing liquid light (representing capital) into a singular, optimized flow.
concepts.motion_language: Organic, fluid physics guiding particles through an evolving, intelligent architecture, demonstrating seamless aggregation and redirection.
concepts.camera_language: Sweeping crane shots reveal the grand scale, then smooth dolly moves follow individual capital streams as they merge and are routed.
concepts.typography_language: Architectural text integrated into the environment, appearing as glowing data points or structural labels within the network.

Secondary motion always guides the eye to the next visual reveal.
Continuous motion vector: velocity and direction carry across the cut into the incoming scene.
Morphing geometry: outward expansion of shapes reveals internal UI contents.
synthesized_composition_principles: Asymmetrical tension in problem scenes resolving into centered symmetrical balance in solution scenes.

Aligned horizon lines and shared optical centers between outgoing and incoming scenes.
